questions.question: If you are stopped at a railroad crossing while driving a school bus, what should you do?

options.text: Get ready to move as soon as the train passes.
Open the door to look and listen for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Open the door to look and listen for trains.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, do not rely only on signals. Tell all passengers to be quiet. Open the front door and look and listen for trains. After a train passes, check both directions for another train before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What tool should you use to check if your tires have the right air pressure?
questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge to check tire pressure. Kicking the tires will not give you a passing grade on the vehicle inspection test.

questions.question: What should the bus driver do while students are getting on and off the bus?
questions.explanation: Watch students as they enter or exit the bus. Make sure they don't get caught in the door or handrails. Also make sure they move far away from the bus after getting off.

questions.question: How many seconds before a school bus stop should the amber warning lights turn on?
questions.explanation: Turn on the amber warning lights at least 5 to 10 seconds (about 200 feet) before you stop, unless your state requires something different.

questions.question: If you need to evacuate the bus, how far from the road should students go?
questions.explanation: Lead students at least 100 feet away from the road in the direction of oncoming traffic. This keeps them safe from debris if another vehicle hits the bus.

questions.question: If you need to get off the bus to check on a student, what should you do?

options.text: Turn off the bus and take the key with you.
Ask a student to watch the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the bus and take the key with you.
questions.explanation: Turn off the bus and take the key. Check around and under the bus for the missing student.

questions.question: How should you approach a school bus stop?
questions.explanation: Always approach bus stops slowly and cautiously.

questions.question: When getting out of your vehicle, how many points of contact must you keep with the vehicle?
questions.explanation: Face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. For a bus, hold the handrail. Not doing this correctly will cause you to fail the basic control skills test.

questions.question: If your ABS stops working, what happens to your brakes?

options.text: You will have no brakes at all.
Your regular brakes will still work.
You should only use the parking brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your regular brakes will still work.
questions.explanation: ABS keeps your wheels from locking up when you brake hard. If ABS fails, your normal brakes still work. Drive and brake normally.

questions.question: What should you not do when crossing railroad tracks during the driving test?

options.text: Pass another vehicle on the tracks.

questions.explanation: While on railroad tracks, do not stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes.

questions.question: The drive shaft should:

options.text: Be bent toward the passenger side.
Be bent toward the driver's side.
Be bent to one side or the other.

questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection test, check that the drive shaft is not bent or cracked.

questions.question: After students get off at school, a driver should:

options.text: Not worry about where the students go.
Leave after the students enter the building.
Walk through the bus to check for sleeping students.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk through the bus to check for sleeping students.
questions.explanation: After students get off at school, walk through the bus to check for sleeping students, hiding students, and items left behind. Students must exit in an orderly way with the driver watching.

questions.question: When alley docking, your vehicle should be parked:

options.text: With the front bumper on the front boundary line.
With the rear wheels over the rear boundary line.
Straight within the parking space boundaries.
At an angle within the parking space boundaries.

questions.correctAnswerText: Straight within the parking space boundaries.
questions.explanation: To alley dock, first pull past the alley and stop parallel to the outer boundary. Back your vehicle into the alley parking area. Your vehicle must be parked straight within the parking space boundaries.

questions.question: Loading a school bus:
questions.explanation: More students are killed during loading or unloading of school buses than while riding in them. School bus drivers must follow proper safety procedures during loading and unloading.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you will:

options.text: Explain what you know about the inspection process.
Watch someone else check your vehicle.
Watch a film about vehicle inspection.
Change all the tires on your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Explain what you know about the inspection process.
questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection test, you will do a complete inspection of your vehicle. You must explain what you are checking and why.

questions.question: When operating a school bus, mirrors should be adjusted:
questions.explanation: Proper mirror adjustment is critical for safe school bus operation. Always check each mirror before you drive.

questions.question: When students board a school bus, the driver should do all of the following, except:

options.text: Tell students when it is safe to board.
Count students and make sure all have boarded.
Allow students to board in pairs.
Check mirrors for students running toward the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allow students to board in pairs.
questions.explanation: Students must board a school bus in a single-file line.

questions.question: To safely unload a bus, students should:

options.text: Stay seated until the driver tells them to exit.
Stand up and walk to the door while the bus is slowing down.
Exit and stand next to the bus while it drives away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay seated until the driver tells them to exit.
questions.explanation: Students must stay seated until the driver tells them it is safe to exit. After exiting, they should walk at least 10 feet away from the bus so the driver can see them clearly.

questions.question: Active railroad crossings:

options.text: Do not have traffic control devices.
Have at least 10 vehicles pass every hour.

questions.explanation: Active railroad crossings have control devices to manage traffic. These include flashing red lights, warning bells, and gates. Drivers must follow the instructions given by these devices.

questions.question: During the driving test, the examiner will score you on:

options.text: How fast you reach your destination.

questions.explanation: During the on-road driving test, the examiner will score you on specific driving maneuvers and your general driving behavior. You must drive safely, obey all traffic signs and laws, and avoid accidents and moving violations.
